title: Nuh Uh
blurb: No counter-evidence, no logic, no engagement with the substance whatsoever. Simply a refusal. The childlike denial became TikTok's official response to accusations, facts and consequences alike, and it is genuinely unanswerable, because responding at all concedes that the exchange is a debate. Surprisingly sophisticated rhetoric, for two syllables produced in a sing-song voice. The most efficient defensive tool in the entire meme arsenal, and the only correct reply to somebody presenting a screenshot of something you definitely said.
origin: A viral childlike denial clip; the internet's official rebuttal to everything.
